AlignedWord.description:
A text span and its proposed half-open source-time interval.
Text offsets are UTF-8 bytes into the selected, corrected cue text.

frameRate.description: Explicit conformance for VFR or mismatched source rates.

Evidence.description:
Distinguish text verified against the active transcript from an agent's own
interpretation of video or audio, which AVW cannot independently verify.

EvidenceQuery.description: A source-time range divided into pages for an external agent to inspect.

MediaRequest.description:
Transport convenience for media which the existing service has inspected
or verified. The caller cannot supply an arbitrary file path.

ProviderSearch.description:
Search a source using an explicitly configured external provider. The
provider receives the original source path under the existing contract.

observer.description: Identity supplied by the observer; it is not independently authenticated.

safeInset.description: Fraction of each output edge to keep clear around observed subjects.

regions.description: Boxes are normalized to the upright source after sample-aspect correction.

TranslationProvenance.description:
Optional, attributable input for a variant operation. The digest binds the
entire explicit proposal; it is not evidence of translation quality.
